entries.label: Brachistochrone cycloid
entries.appropriate_test: travel time of frictionless point particle under constant gravity at matched endpoints; add friction/rolling inertia separately

entries.label: Honeycomb edge network
entries.existing_registry_relation: related to flower_of_life_hexagonal_packing but not identical; circle-packing centers form a triangular lattice, whereas honeycomb vertices have degree three in the interior
entries.model: regular hexagonal edge lattice, finite open-boundary patch
entries.appropriate_test: conductance, stiffness or pressure drop with domain-specific equal-material controls

entries.label: Sunflower / golden-angle phyllotaxis
entries.evidence_status: exact_point_generator plus exploratory synthetic graph; no optimality result
entries.appropriate_test: packing, sensor coverage or manufacturing constraints; graph topology must be specified separately

entries.label: Branching tree / Murray-radius illustration
entries.possible_user_alias: Tree of Life (ambiguous: artistic motif, evolutionary tree or branching transport can mean different things)
entries.existing_registry_relation: existing Geometry Championship family; preserve original readiness status
entries.model: binary branching graph with default r_parent^3 = r_child1^3+r_child2^3
entries.evidence_status: cubic-radius algebra and topology verified; no fluid solver
entries.appropriate_test: specified fluid, viscosity, pressure/flow boundary data, Poiseuille validity, radius budget and stress limits

entries.label: Mycelium-inspired network
entries.existing_registry_relation: existing family; historical financial-transform result remains separate and unchanged
entries.model: our demonstrator is an MST with greedy loop closures; not a model of fungal biology
entries.appropriate_test: matched terminal routing demands, capacities and fault scenarios; compare against MST, shortest paths and redundant routing

sources.title: Euclid, Elements, Book XIII, Proposition 18
sources.kind: primary mathematical text, Clark University translation
sources.supports: Five regular convex Platonic solids. Not a claim that all matter consists of five shapes.

sources.title: Putland, The cycloid as brachistochrone (2025)
sources.supports: Frictionless fastest descent under uniform gravity from rest; not a light or communications routing theorem.

sources.title: Hales, The Honeycomb Conjecture (2001)
sources.kind: author paper, published in Discrete & Computational Geometry
sources.supports: Regular hexagonal honeycomb minimizes perimeter for equal-area plane partitions; does not establish conductor, signal or hydraulic superiority.

sources.title: Vogel, A better way to construct the sunflower head (1979)
sources.kind: primary mathematical model paper; abstract retrieved, publisher full text access-limited
sources.supports: Sunflower phyllotaxis as mathematical point placement; our half-offset radius rule is a stated finite-sample variant.

sources.title: Murray, The Physiological Principle of Minimum Work: I. The Vascular System and the Cost of Blood Volume (1926)
sources.supports: Minimum-work vascular modeling under flow and volume assumptions.

sources.title: Price, Knox and Brodribb, The Influence of Branch Order on Optimal Leaf Vein Geometries: Murray’s Law and Area Preserving Branching (2013)
sources.supports: Cubic-radius Murray relation and branch-order-dependent biological limitations; not one universal Tree of Life equation.

sources.title: Haus and Melcher, Electromagnetic Fields and Energy, Chapter 14
sources.kind: authors’ engineering textbook hosted by MIT
sources.supports: Signal modeling requires transmission-line dynamics, matching, impedance, reflections and dissipation beyond a DC resistor graph.

interpretation: Geometries are useful candidate models, not a finite list of shapes from which all reality is scientifically known to be constructed. No single universal Tree of Life equation is asserted.
